sessions.empty: No agent is running. Choose a folder via “Start a new agent”.
sessions.confirmEffort: Set the effort for “{name}” to “{effort}”? It applies to the project; the agent briefly restarts and resumes the conversation.
sessions.confirmStop: Stop the agent in “{name}”? The conversation is kept and can be resumed.
sessions.confirmEffortBusy: “{name}” is working on an answer. The effort “{effort}” can apply once it is finished – or right away, which cancels the answer in progress.
sessions.effortPending: Change to “{effort}” scheduled – after the current answer

scope.unlockHint: Your whole home directory becomes accessible for {minutes} minutes. Enter your password to confirm.

agent.title: Start agent in “{name}”
agent.recentlyActive: recently active – may still be open elsewhere

trash.confirmEmpty: Permanently delete all {count} entries? This cannot be undone.
trash.confirmDelete: Permanently delete “{name}”? This cannot be undone.

editor.unsavedMessage: Your changes are not saved yet. Leave anyway?

errors.OutsideScopeError: This location is outside the allowed area.
errors.FolderBusyError: An agent is still running in this folder. Stop it first.
errors.SessionAlreadyRunningError: An agent is already running in this folder.
errors.FileExistsError: An entry with this name already exists.
errors.RestoreConflictError: Something with the same name now exists at the original location.
errors.InvalidNameError: Invalid name. Letters, digits, dot, dash and underscore are allowed.
errors.FileTooLargeError: The file is too large for the editor.
errors.NotTextError: This is not a text file.
errors.FileConflictError: The file has changed in the meantime, for example by the agent.
errors.TrashEntryNotFoundError: This entry is no longer in the trash.
errors.http429: Too many failed attempts. Please wait {minutes} minutes.
errors.GpuUnavailableError: No GPU has room for Whisper right now. Switch to CPU.
errors.UnsupportedAudioError: Whisper cannot process this audio format.

dictation.device: Whisper on GPU (instant) or CPU (slower, always available)
dictation.browserHint: Whisper failed: use the browser's speech recognition (Chrome sends the audio to Google)

quota.title: {agent} usage
quota.none: No data yet – appears once a session has worked.
